title: CROSS-SURVEY / MULTI-UNIVERSE EMPIRICAL FIELD COMPOSITION COURT

respondent_universe_definition.definition: An authority-bound empirical observation/sample-space identity over a governed source/study release, instrument, geography, time, target population/sample frame/design, respondent namespace, question/routing/topology semantics, measure/weight regime, and immutable provenance.
respondent_universe_definition.same_universe_rule: SAME_UNIVERSE only when positive authority proves the observations are nonduplicative partitions/continuations/representations of the same intended sample universe on all material identity axes.
respondent_universe_definition.normalization_rule: Canonical family/wave/country normalization resolves names and scope tokens; it cannot create sample, person, semantic, or pooling authority.

exact_join_authorized_when: positive respondent-namespace equivalence or cross-namespace person-linkage authority
stable governed person key and linkage grain
false_join_court.panel_linkage_effect: May authorize exact person join across DISTINCT_UNIVERSES; does not authorize pooling repeated observations as one cross-section.

pooling_court.pooling_authorized_when: Positive authority proves one intended sample/estimand, nonduplicative partition or continuation, compatible instrument/routing/topology/design/weights/target population/scope, and exact provenance.

current_authority_evidence.survey_identity: ddm_survey_identity.py explicitly normalizes family/wave/country while stating adapters may normalize naming but may not create authority.
current_authority_evidence.family_overlays: ddm_v550_family_overlay.py is family-dispatched, wave-alias aware, fail-closed, and refuses non-GSS fallback to GSS; source/wave columns are identity-validated when present.
current_authority_evidence.response_scales: response_scale_encoding_registry_35wave_active_v1 is contract-hashed and source-provenanced; shared labels/response-family names do not imply identical coordinate geometry.
current_authority_evidence.final_r1: Final R1 governs source implementations and carries canonical_wave/country scope plus fail-closed source/identity blockers; it is relation-semantic authority, not cross-survey sample pooling authority.
current_authority_evidence.v553: Current V553 harmonization requires one survey family and one country per report, at least two waves, shared semantic/directionality/position structure, and certified wave authority; it preserves wave differences and does not create person joins.
current_authority_evidence.v553_canonical_boundary: Producer identity is checked on run/source/wave/country and mismatches fail closed.
current_authority_evidence.d08: Empirical fact identity includes source/wave/country, predicate/risk-set/topology/measure/provenance; raw and weighted measures are distinct.
current_authority_evidence.d05: Populated respondent overlap, duplicates, weight coverage and source equivalence remain unknown without database access.
current_authority_evidence.d10: Raw empirical coordinates do not directly bind generated structural position; D12G does not use cross-survey composition to bypass that rule.
current_authority_evidence.parent_corrective_15: Target machine requires forward discovery, reverse positioned-subject empirical possibility inference, and structural/stratal field production as separate services; cross-universe disagreement must not be flattened or used as direct psyche.

forward_discovery.within_universe: May discover respondent-bound E1/E2 conditionals, joints, forks, minority and higher-order configurations when separately authorized.
forward_discovery.cross_universe: COMPARE_SEPARATELY over source-indexed facts/configurations; cross-universe comparison is not same-respondent cotravel.
forward_discovery.false_joint: FORBIDDEN without exact person linkage. Shared Q1 or same respondent_id string cannot horizontally stitch distinct surveys.
forward_discovery.disagreement: May itself be a discovery output.

reverse_possibility_field.actor_conditioner_crosswalk: Outside D12G; exact generated-actor-to-empirical-conditioner authority remains separately required.
reverse_possibility_field.universe_applicability: Each source needs independent geography/target-population/time/instrument/topology/risk-set/design/provenance applicability authority.
reverse_possibility_field.disagreement: DISAGREEMENT_IS_INFORMATION when multiple admitted source-indexed components differ.

structural_field.rule: A structural producer may use broader/different universes only under its own structural evidence/admission authority.
structural_field.service_separation: Source admissibility for structural field, reverse field, and forward discovery must be governed independently.

case_rulings.D: DISTINCT_UNIVERSES; POOLING_FORBIDDEN absent exact cross-scale authority
case_rulings.E: DISTINCT_UNIVERSES; BACKFILL_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY; DOUBLE_COUNTING_RISK if constituent overlap exists
case_rulings.G: RESPONDENT_JOIN_FORBIDDEN; no synthetic cross-survey joint incidence
case_rulings.L: SOURCE_INDEXED_FIELD_REQUIRED; DISAGREEMENT_IS_INFORMATION; absence in B cannot erase A
case_rulings.N: Sparse local does not authorize regional substitution; BACKFILL_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY
case_rulings.O: Different services may lawfully use different source universes under separate authority

additional_hostile_rulings.P_exact_nonoverlap_shards: SAME_UNIVERSE and POOLING_AUTHORIZED only with positive partition/design/nonoverlap proof
additional_hostile_rulings.Q_exact_panel_linkage: EXACT_RESPONDENT_JOIN_AUTHORIZED across DISTINCT_UNIVERSES; POOLING_FORBIDDEN for undifferentiated cross-section
additional_hostile_rulings.T_regional_plus_included_country_sample: DOUBLE_COUNTING_RISK if inclusion proven; otherwise UNPROVEN

composition_model_semantic_requirements_: exact provenance to each input fact
nonclaims: No D12 closure or binding terminal-capability verdict.
No actual source overlap, duplicate coverage, prevalence, support or weight-quality claim.
No actual source ranking or numeric source weights.
No cross-survey respondent join without exact linkage authority.
No raw empirical coordinate to generated-position binding.
No population statistic to actor belief/persona inference.
